step1_analysis.description: A three-stage inverter chain acting as a switch driver for a current-steering DAC. It generates complementary signals (IN_L, IN_R) from the input (IN) to drive the differential current switches. The separate PMOS source node N3 might be used for crossing-point adjustment or isolated power supply routing.

paper_reference.title: Parallel-Path Digital-to-Analog Converters for Nyquist Signal Generation

delay_in_inl.description: Propagation delay from IN to IN_L (non-inverting, 2 stages)

sky130_expected.calculation: Two inverter stages with L=0.5um. Delay ~ 2 * 100ps = 200ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Using L=0.5um makes the gates slower than minimum length (0.15um) devices in SKY130.

delay_in_inr.description: Propagation delay from IN to IN_R (inverting, 3 stages)

sky130_expected.calculation: Three inverter stages with L=0.5um. Delay ~ 3 * 100ps = 300ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Expected to be one stage delay longer than IN_L.

v_cross.description: Crossing voltage of the complementary outputs IN_L and IN_R

sky130_expected.calculation: With equal W=5um for NMOS and PMOS, the PMOS is weaker, shifting the crossing point below VDD/2.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Crucial metric for DAC switch drivers to minimize glitch energy by controlling the simultaneous on/off state of the differential switches.

trise_inl.description: Rise time of the IN_L output (20% to 80%)

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by PMOS drive strength and load capacitance. C_load ~ 25fF. t_rise ~ 2.2 * R_p * C_load ~ 150ps.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure propagation delays, rise/fall times, crossing voltage, and average power of the DAC switch driver at 250 MHz.
step3_testbench.spice:
* DAC Switch Driver Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u

XM3 IN_L N2 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 IN_L N2 N3 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM2 N2 IN N3 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM1 N2 IN GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM6 IN_R IN_L N3 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM5 IN_R IN_L GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}

* Power Supplies
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VN3 N3 0 1.8

* Input Signal (250 MHz -> 4ns period)
VIN IN 0 PULSE(0 1.8 1n 100p 100p 1.9n 4n)

.control
tran 10p 20n

* Measure Delays
meas tran delay_in_inl trig v(IN) val=0.9 rise=2 targ v(IN_L) val=0.9 rise=2
meas tran delay_in_inr trig v(IN) val=0.9 rise=2 targ v(IN_R) val=0.9 fall=2

* Measure Rise and Fall Times
meas tran trise_inl trig v(IN_L) val=0.36 rise=2 targ v(IN_L) val=1.44 rise=2
meas tran tfall_inl trig v(IN_L) val=1.44 fall=2 targ v(IN_L) val=0.36 fall=2
meas tran trise_inr trig v(IN_R) val=0.36 rise=2 targ v(IN_R) val=1.44 rise=2
meas tran tfall_inr trig v(IN_R) val=1.44 fall=2 targ v(IN_R) val=0.36 fall=2

* Measure Crossing Point
let vdiff = v(IN_L) - v(IN_R)
meas tran t_cross when vdiff=0 cross=3
meas tran v_cross find v(IN_L) at=t_cross

* Measure Average Power
let pwr = - (i(VVDD) + i(VN3)) * 1.8
meas tran avg_pwr avg pwr from=4n to=16n

print delay_in_inl delay_in_inr trise_inl tfall_inl trise_inr tfall_inr v_cross avg_pwr
quit
.endc
